verdict.rationale: Reflect documents end-to-end encryption, stating that no one, including Reflect, can read note contents and that its servers can't serve them via the API. That indirectly keeps notes from vendor-side model training. However, there is no explicit no-training policy or opt-out, and uploaded files and images are not E2E encrypted. Its AI features also route content to OpenAI and Anthropic models with no documented training terms. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that user data is not used for AI training, a user-facing training opt-out control, documented training terms for content sent to third-party LLM providers, coverage of non-encrypted files and images, and independent corroboration.
